artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the thumb is slightly overly smooth/plastic-like compared to the rest of the hand, lacking fine pore detail, which is a common AI generation trait.
The bottom edge of the lighter seems to blend slightly into the shadow of the hand without a crisp boundary, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity.
The connection point between the flame and the nozzle is somewhat diffuse; real flames usually have a sharper anchor point at the gas exit.
